Estimate Momentum measures change in analyst sentiment over time and may be an indicator of future price movements. The Change in Consensus chart shows the current, 1 week ago, and 1 month ago consensus earnings per share (EPS*) forecasts.
 For the fiscal quarter endingDec 2026 , the consensus EPS* forecast has remained the same over the past week at 4.86 and increased over the past month from 4.84 to 4.86(0.41%). Of the 11 analysts making quarterly forecasts, 7raised and 7 lowered their forecast.
 For the fiscal year ending Jun 2027 , the consensus EPS* forecast has remained the same over the past week at 19.91 and increased over the past month from 19.65 to 19.91(1.32%). Of the 8 analysts making yearly forecasts, 8raised and none lowered their forecast.
